upstream.drop_when: The selected f2fs-tools release must offer no-write layout preflight and growth after online shrink without relocating the main area or file data, while preserving checkpoint payloads and NAT/SIT maps and checking SIT/SSA capacity. Update the Android caller's options together and verify shrink/grow data integrity and encrypted-volume compatibility.

The selected fsck.f2fs must discard only empty SIT journal records beyond an online-shrunk main area, compact surviving records without truncation and reject nonempty out-of-range entries before resize writes. Verify shrink/grow and malformed-journal cases with the Android expansion tools.
